s3.name: Simple Storage Service (S3)
s3.description: A boundless repository where digital artifacts are preserved for eternity. Like an enchanted chest with infinite capacity, it safeguards your mystical scrolls and arcane images.
s3.use_cases:
• Hosting ethereal web presences
• Archiving ancient knowledge
• Creating lakes of wisdom
• Storing magical artifacts

ec2.name: Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2)
ec2.description: Conjure virtual thinking entities that manifest your will in the digital realm. These ethereal constructs can be summoned or banished at your command.
ec2.use_cases:
• Hosting mystical applications
• Processing arcane calculations
• Serving as vessels for your digital creations
• Scaling your magical workloads

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.description: Invoke ephemeral spells that materialize only when needed, then fade back into the ether. These spectral functions require no persistent vessel to manifest their power.
lambda.use_cases:
• Responding to mystical events
• Processing arcane data
• Creating serverless enchantments
• Automating magical workflows

dynamodb.name: DynamoDB
dynamodb.description: A magical tome that expands to accommodate any volume of arcane knowledge. Its pages reorganize themselves instantly to reveal exactly what you seek.
dynamodb.use_cases:
• Storing enchanted items
• Cataloging user profiles
• Recording mystical events
• Maintaining session states

rds.name: Relational Database Service (RDS)
rds.description: A meticulously organized library where knowledge is stored in interconnected tomes. The magical librarians maintain order and protect against dark forces.
rds.use_cases:
• Preserving structured knowledge
• Maintaining relational wisdom
• Hosting traditional database engines
• Automating arcane maintenance

sns.name: Simple Notification Service (SNS)
sns.description: A network of spectral messengers that carry your proclamations across the digital realm. They ensure your words reach all intended recipients simultaneously.
sns.use_cases:
• Broadcasting mystical announcements
• Triggering cascading enchantments
• Notifying mortal users
• Decoupling magical systems

sqs.name: Simple Queue Service (SQS)
sqs.description: Mystical pools where tasks await their turn to be fulfilled. These pools ensure no magical work is lost, even when the cosmic forces are turbulent.
sqs.use_cases:
• Decoupling system components
• Managing task backlogs
• Ensuring message processing
• Handling traffic spikes

cloudfront.name: CloudFront
cloudfront.description: A constellation of mystical mirrors that reflect your content across the mortal realm. These mirrors bring your enchantments closer to those who seek them.
cloudfront.use_cases:
• Accelerating content delivery
• Protecting against dark forces
• Reducing origin burden
• Distributing global content

iam.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
iam.description: The vigilant guardian that determines which entities may access your mystical resources. It grants or denies passage based on ancient scrolls of permission.
iam.use_cases:
• Controlling access to resources
• Creating magical roles
• Managing user identities
• Implementing principle of least privilege

cloudwatch.name: CloudWatch
cloudwatch.description: A mystical orb that observes all activities within your realm. It can alert you when anomalies appear or when thresholds of power are crossed.
cloudwatch.use_cases:
• Monitoring magical resources
• Observing application health
• Triggering automated responses
• Collecting and analyzing metrics

route53.name: Route 53
route53.description: An enchanted map that guides seekers to your digital domains. It translates arcane runes (domain names) into the numeric coordinates of your realms.
route53.use_cases:
• Registering mystical domains
• Directing traffic to resources
• Health checking your enchantments
• Implementing routing policies

vpc.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
vpc.description: A protected pocket dimension where your mystical resources can exist in isolation. Within these boundaries, you control all aspects of connectivity and security.
vpc.use_cases:
• Creating isolated networks
• Defining security boundaries
• Controlling ingress and egress
• Connecting to other realms

efs.name: Elastic File System (EFS)
efs.description: A magical tome that can be read and written by multiple entities simultaneously. It expands as needed to accommodate growing knowledge.
efs.use_cases:
• Sharing files between constructs
• Storing application data
• Supporting content management
• Enabling collaborative workspaces

cloudformation.name: CloudFormation
cloudformation.description: Ancient scrolls that, when recited, manifest entire infrastructures from the void. These scrolls ensure your realm is constructed identically each time.
cloudformation.use_cases:
• Creating infrastructure as code
• Automating resource provisioning
• Maintaining consistent environments
• Managing complex deployments

apigateway.name: API Gateway
apigateway.description: A mystical doorkeeper that manages the thresholds between realms. It controls who may pass through your portals and how they may interact with what lies beyond.
apigateway.use_cases:
• Creating RESTful interfaces
• Managing API access
• Transforming and validating requests
• Connecting to backend services
